# MCES - Modern Common Economy & Shop

> Configurable shop for Arma Reforger missions (Enforce Script). Mod GUID AE9A7FAB88A56E07; depends on MCUIK (B8DFCB8639E9DA37).
> - **The shop window:** category tabs, cards with a 3D item preview, and a detail panel.
> - **Networking:** client purchase request → server → reply to that player only.
> - **The mission's part:** the catalog (.conf MCES_ShopConfig or script) and a provider class that holds its economy.
> The documentation is in Spanish.

Key facts for agents:
- Subclass MCES_ShopProvider. Register it with MCES_Shop.SetProvider(new X()) on BOTH server and clients.
- Buy(pid, player, shopId, itemId, source, out msg) runs on the SERVER and is the only source of truth. It must validate the item, its locked state, the server-side price, the balance and the distance to the seller, then charge and deliver.
- GetBalance() runs on the client and must read a replicated value.
- Open the shop on the client with MCES_Shop.Open(shopId, sellerEntity).
- MCES_Item.m_sId is what travels over the network. Copy prefab GUIDs from real resources; never invent them.
